exercise.staffing_review: The Finance Operations Manager keeps every post in the six roles shown. Agents route complete cases, but the Accounts Payable Lead keeps the routing rule, the exceptions and the agents' supervision, and analysts still check unusual evidence, so no post is removed. The Exception Analyst moves to report to the Controller, which needs the Controller's approval. Post counts within each role and across the rest of the 40-person operation were not examined.
